input.quote: Nothing herein is intended nor shall be construed as creating an exclusive arrangement between Customer and Kubient. This Agreement will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents or otherwise selling Inventory to any third parties.
input.rationale: Section 1 (p0001) expressly disclaims any exclusive arrangement and confirms that the Agreement does not restrict us from offering Inventory via other agents or selling Inventory to third parties, so we carry no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation — the preferred position. A full read of the operative text and the definitions (Services, Inventory, Auction Platform) found no requirements commitment, minimum volume, first-look or no-third-party-procurement covenant; the only "exclusive" references elsewhere concern the New York merits forum (p0064), each Party's own trademarks (p0065), the entire-agreement wording (p0072) and third-party beneficiaries (p0073), and the Kubient licence to us is non-exclusive (p0002). The single point worth noting (not a deviation) is Section 5 (p0023), under which Kubient "shall be responsible for contracting with all advertisers, agencies, media buyers, and/or sponsors ... on Customer's behalf, including Advertisers with whom Customer has existing relationships" unless an Exhibit says otherwise; that allocates Kubient's role for Services delivered through the Auction Platform and is expressly subject to our Section 1 freedom to use other agents and channels, so it is not exclusive dealing. No redline required.
